import bpy
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['reference_authoring']
exec("
from mathutils import Vector
changed=[]
for o in bpy.data.collections['Reference_Coast'].objects:
    center=sum((o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box),Vector())/8
    if center.x<10.8 and abs(center.y+34)<2.1:
        o.location.y-=4.0;changed.append(o.name)
bpy.context.view_layer.update()
export_collection('Reference_Coast','coast.glb')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=str(ROOT/'source/reference_harbor_mcp.blend'))
print('DOCK_CLEARANCE_MOVE',len(changed),'components from z34 to z38')
",ns)
